answer: Farming becomes a tundra bet on surviving 88 epochs of grading, and every voyage settlement recomputes the knoll schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 88 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 7 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
